item.title: Zane Durant Opts Out of Pinstripe Bowl, Declares for NFL Draft
item.description: It's the end of the road for one Nittany Lion. On Monday afternoon, Penn State defensive tackle Zane Durant announced on Instagram he's opting out of the Pinstripe Bowl and will declare for this year's NFL draft after exhausting his eligibility. The senior had the opportunity to declare a year ago and was part of a large contingent of Nittany Lions who returned for this season. Durant has a wide range of draft projections, but the general consensus is he'll be selected in the mid-to-late rounds.

item.title: Developer Presents Final Plan for New Student Housing Complex on Penn State Campus
item.description: State College Planning Commission on Dec. 3 reviewed a final land development plan for a new student housing complex to be constructed on Penn State's University Park campus in a public-private partnership. item.title: 7 Brew Celebrates Opening of First State College Area Location
item.description: 7 Brew officially cut the ribbon Tuesday on its first State College-area location at 1923 S. Atherton St. in the Hills Plaza. The drive-thru stand, part of a national chain offering coffee, tea, smoothies and energy drinks, began serving customers on Friday. The opening included a check presented to THON, the Penn State student-run philanthropy supporting pediatric cancer research and care. The company is known for partnering with local nonprofits in each community where it launches new stores.

item.title: Penn State Faculty File for Union Election
item.description: Penn State faculty will vote on unionizing in 2026 after filing a petition for an election with the Pennsylvania Labor Relations Board on Tuesday.
